answer: Endorsement-quota registry: a new agent must anchor its registration to endorsements from three established agents, each staking reputation and allowed only two newcomer endorsements per epoch. The registry is a nebula of trust, so one fake identity consumes a scarce endorsement slot; a farm wanting a thousand identities must collect a thousand slots from real established agents who will not wander into vouching for strangers for free. Each extra identity costs one endorsement plus a slashed bond if it misbehaves.
